description:
Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo de ações da atenção básica. Promover ações que propiciem a redução de incapacidades e deficiências com vistas à melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos, favorecendo sua reinserção social, combatendo a discriminação e ampliando o acesso ao sistema de saúde. Formular projetos terapêuticos únicos que considerem a pessoa, suas necessidades e o significado da deficiência no contexto familiar e social.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência com CEDTEA, para atender crianças em Reabilitação Intelectual;
  • Pós Graduação e/ou Especialização na area de reabilitação.

Additional information

Local: Praça Seca

Horário de Trabalho: 20h semanais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Para compor o quadro de profissionais para atender ao Hospital da Maternidade Paulino Werneck. Na função de Técnico de Enfermagem-CC, desempenhando as seguintes funções:

  • Incentiva a proteção e promoção do aleitamento materno, cuidado integral individual e humanizado ao cliente e família.

Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Cybersecurity will oversee and enhance the university's cybersecurity program within a sophisticated hybrid IT environment. This position combines visionary leadership typical of a cybersecurity executive with extensive technical expertise similar to that of a Security Architect and Engineer. The Senior Director will have primary accountability for securing the university's systems, applications, networks, and data, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, and guiding technical teams in initiatives focused on threat prevention and mitigation.

Supervisory Authority

The Senior Director of Cybersecurity will supervise a team of cybersecurity professionals, including managers, engineers, and analysts. This position holds the authority to make decisions regarding hiring, training, performance evaluations, and disciplinary actions within the cybersecurity department.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, students and staff of the department and University and Howard University Hospital CIO. External contacts include vendors, consultants, investigators, auditors, etc. Collaborate closely with the Chief Audit and Compliance Officer.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Develop and execute a university-wide cybersecurity strategy that aligns with Howard University’s goals and emerging threat landscapes
  • Lead cross-functional cybersecurity governance initiatives, partnering with senior academic and administrative leaders to promote a security-first culture

  • Evaluate and select enterprise-class security solutions: firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel), endpoint detection and response (EDR), encryption, and data loss prevention (DLP)

  • Manage vulnerability management programs and ensure timely patch management across all systems
  • Maintain and test business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) plans related to information security incidents
  • Coordinate with other departments to integrate cybersecurity measures into business processes
  • Monitor and analyze security metrics to provide insights and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Stay informed about the latest cybersecurity trends, threats, and technologies

Core Competencies

Expert experience in the following:

  • Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
  • Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, RAIDUS PS, CAs

description:
Overview

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes, que utiliza as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio. Trabalhará junto de uma equipe de mais de 13.000 colaboradores em instalações de última geração, ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor, com foco em desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira e mobilidade dentro do grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo, e em pensar nas melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

Responsabilidades

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Requisitos

  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperamos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. Overview

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive-level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi-phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi-dimensional models that support real-time decision-making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
  • Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long-term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge-sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data-driven decision-making

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project-driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels

About Us: SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As Material Controller, your core responsibility is to manage and maintain the flow of materials required for projects and for the operations. Your role is crucial in ensuring the efficient and effective management of materials and inventory to support uninterrupted project and operations’ execution. This role requires a strong understanding of supply chain management, inventory control, and coordination with multiple departments to support project timelines and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Inventory Management: You maintain and lead accurate counting and records of material in stock. You oversee material handling, storage, and preservation to prevent damage, loss, or deterioration of materials. You ensure that the storage areas are kept clean and organized.
  • Material Movement: You keep records of the in and out stock movements. You initiate, treat and coordinate the demand of transfer and move of material between storage locations. You handle the distribution of materials, supplies, and equipment based on incoming requests and orders.
  • Coordination: You maintain good communication with the yard, the warehouse or cargo teams with regards to equipment that requires additional coordination from them.
  • Documentation: You maintain and lead the maintenance of comprehensive material records, including receipts, issuances, and transfers, and generate/oversee reports for management and audit purposes.
  • Compliance: You ensure adherence to relevant safety, environmental, and industry regulations in all material-related activities.
  • Material Planning: You track material consumption, and you collaborate with Projects, Maintenance and Supply Chain teams to support the material requirement forecast and to develop effective material planning strategies. You support the identification of potential material shortages, bottlenecks, and supply chain risks. You support the implementation of proactive measures to mitigate risks and develop contingency plans to address unexpected challenges.
  • Material Replenishment: If you are involved in the material replenishment process, you initiate the demand and the replenishment tasks. You coordinate replenishment or material transfer processes to avoid shortages and surplus.
  • Inspection and material Quality Control: If you are involved in the material reception process, you verify and lead the verification of the quality and specifications of incoming materials. You conduct and lead inspections and address any discrepancies or non-compliance issues.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Stock Management, Supply chain, or Logistics Management.

Experience

  • Proven track record in material control or inventory management within the oil and gas industry or a similar sector.
  • Good knowledge of materials used in oil and gas operations, including equipment and spare parts, and industry specific regulations.
  • Understanding of the procurement processes.
  • Strong experience in warehouse management systems and inventory tracking tool. Knowledge of ERP systems and data analysis tools being preferable.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to optimize material usage and reduce waste.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail to maintain accurate records and comply with industry standards.
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate.

Functional Competencies

Logistics Quality Control Plans Inspection, testing, commissioning and monitoring Purchasing Tools and Processes Contract Management

General Information

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”).   • Perform networking and security troubleshooting.

  • Installing, configure, and maintain network, network security, and VoIP systems.

  • Stays informed of new developments and technologies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Working knowledge and experience in local and wide area networking, communications, and related hardware and software.

  • Strong interpersonal skills as well as strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all internal customers.

  • Knowledge of standard project management methodologies and project life cycle phases.
  • Ability to gather user requirements, to complete systems analysis, and to create general systems design.
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate technical requirements and specifications.
  • Ability to identify key milestones for medium-sized projects, and to create project plans.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree desired in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related technical experience. At least five (4) years of experience and/or certifications in one or more of the following technologies: Cisco Systems; Aruba Wireless; Extreme Wireless; Cisco Wireless; Cisco Meraki. Excellent knowledge of TCP/IP, routing and switching. Good oral and written communication skills. Excellent customer service skills. Preferred Knowledge/Experience: General Windows skills. Physical Requirements: Ability to perform network hardware installation which could include lifting, moving, and installing equipment up to 50 lbs.

title: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people - people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. Ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend's "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

The Technology Stack

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect‑Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands‑on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy‑focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Overview

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

The Technology Stack

You Do Not Need To Be An Expert In Every Single Tool, But You Must Be Able To Discuss Technical Trade-offs Across The Entire Stack

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

  • Contato inicial: Você entra em contato com o potencial cliente e apresenta, de forma simples, as oportunidades que a Clarke oferece.

  • Quem pode ser indicado? Qualquer empresa atendida em média ou alta tensão. Normalmente, empresas que têm conta de luz acima de R$7 mil reais mensais se enquadram nesse perfil.
  • Com quem falar? Donos, diretores e gerentes, explicando de forma simples como a Clarke pode ajudá-los a economizar.
  • Por que é fácil?
  • O mercado livre de energia reduz custos sem necessidade de investimento inicial para empresas em média ou alta tensão;
  • A Clarke é uma gestora independente que assessora clientes cuidando de toda migração, buscando os melhores contratos com mais de 75 fornecedores de energia e acompanhando toda a vida dos clientes no mercado para que não percam nenhuma oportunidade;
  • Segurança e credibilidade de uma empresa do Grupo Energisa.
  • Ganhos atrativos e sem limite!
  • Valor fixo por indicação validada, mesmo que a negociação não avance;
  • Comissões sobre contratos fechados!

title: Workday Financials Senior Analyst
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Howard is seeking a highly skilled Workday Financials Senior Analyst to support stability, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of the Workday Financials platform. This role serves as a key post-production resource within Finance Administration, combining deep functional expertise with technical Workday Financials know how, analytical and collaboration skills to ensure accurate financial processing, efficient workflows, and effective system adoption.

Supervisory Authority

This position does not have supervisory authority. Sole contributor.

Nature And Scope

This role is responsible for post-production support and optimization initiatives of Workday Financials, with functional coverage across Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, Foundational Data Model (FDM), Projects, and Record-to-Report. The Senior Analyst owns the configuration and maintenance of accounting posting rules, custom validations, financial accounting business processes, and reporting solutions, and works closely with Accounting/Finance stakeholders and cross-functional partners to ensure Workday Financials aligns with accounting, reporting, and operational requirements.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Execute the day-to-day post-production support for Workday Financials, including enhancement and optimization, break/fix resolution, release management, and deployment of new features and functionality.
  • Lead functional analysis, design, configuration, testing, and delivery of Workday Financials solutions to support Finance Administration and institutional business needs.
  • Maintain and optimize accounting configurations, posting rules, validations, and related business processes to ensure accurate financial transactions and reporting.
  • Coordinate and lead system testing activities, including regression testing and user acceptance testing (UAT), to ensure system changes are production-ready and minimally disruptive.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to end-users on the effective use of Workday Financials, ensuring users are fully equipped to leverage the platform’s capabilities.
  • Lead system testing for new features, configurations, and system upgrades, ensuring seamless transition and minimal disruption to business processes.
  • Partner with subject matter experts and cross function teams to document requirements, develop use cases, and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Collaborate with Finance leadership and team members to support post-production road-mapping, continuous improvement initiatives, and timely delivery of system solutions.

Core Competencies

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly summarize the financial accounting and reporting impact of system configurations and changes.
  • Strong organizational and execution skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and deliver results under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to translate accounting and reporting requirements into effective system solutions.
  • An active an agile learner with a commitment to continuous improvement and the application of new knowledge to evolving institutional needs. An ability to stay updated with Workday features, tools, and best practices through continuous learning and training.
  • Demonstrated understanding of process reengineering and the design and implementation of business process workflows, approvals, and reporting enhancements.

Minimum Requirements

  • MBA, MIS, or a bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, computer science or related field from an accredited University, with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Workday certification or demonstrated proficiency in at least two Workday Financial Management areas: Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, Expenses, Foundational Data Model (FDM), Projects, Record-to-Report. Candidates who do not currently hold required certification must obtain or demonstrate proficiency within twelve (12) months of employment.
  • Experience with Workday’s reporting tools, such as Report Writer.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain respectful, collaborative working relationships with staff, faculty, students, and stakeholders.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$120,000-$130,000

What the day will look like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Note: This is a contract-to-hire position

MUST HAVE:

  • Demonstrated experience driving video performance, engagement, and watch time, ideally in a revenue-focused environment
  • Strong understanding of video syndication platforms (MSN preferred) and how they reward engagement
  • Hands-on experience with scriptwriting, editing feedback, and video optimization
  • Comfort managing freelancers, assigning work, and overseeing quality and deadlines
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple projects at once
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a remote environment
  • Willingness to experiment, test, and iterate quickly
  • Openness to incorporating AI tools into scripting, ideation, and workflow optimization

EXPERIENCE: 3+ years in video strategy, video production, or performance-driven video roles within digital media, performance marketing, or content monetization. Personal finance experience or familiarity strongly preferred.

YOUR ROLE

You’ll own the strategy, planning, and performance of FinanceBuzz’s video content, with a primary focus on syndication platforms (especially MSN) where revenue is driven by consumed seconds of video. Secondarily, you’ll support video publishing and optimization for YouTube and social platforms.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll be directly involved in topic selection, scripting, editing feedback, thumbnail and on-screen graphic optimization, and performance analysis. Your goal is simple but ambitious: scale video revenue significantly over time while maintaining high-quality, trustworthy personal finance content.

To succeed in this role, you’ll need strong instincts for what keeps viewers watching, comfort working with performance data, and the ability to manage multiple contributors and workflows at once. You should be equally comfortable zooming out to plan a content roadmap and zooming in to rewrite a script or leave frame-by-frame feedback.

This role is contract-to-hire and will play a key role in growing video from its current state (~$15K/month) into a $500K+ annual revenue stream.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Selecting video topics that consistently maximize viewer engagement, watch time, and revenue
  • Optimizing scripts to increase retention, clarity, and completion rates
  • Improving thumbnail and on-screen graphic performance through testing and iteration
  • Building and maintaining an efficient, scalable video workflow
  • Managing freelancers effectively: assigning work, giving clear feedback, and coordinating payments and budgets
  • Maintaining high quality and brand consistency across all video content
  • Monitoring video performance metrics and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Growing video revenue from its current level toward a $500K+ annual run rate
  • Establishing FinanceBuzz as a trusted and engaging personal finance video brand

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the video content strategy for syndication platforms, with a primary focus on MSN
  • Plan and maintain the video content calendar
  • Write, edit, and optimize video scripts

title: Onboarding Manager (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , MonetizeMore focuses on proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals. You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts—you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. 2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher\'s specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. 3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-to-day Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don\'t just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers\' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves:

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have:

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Howard is seeking a highly skilled Workday Financials Senior Analyst – Record-to-Report (Lead) to support and enhance the University’s Record-to-Report (R2R) operations. This role provides advanced functional leadership across Workday Financials, Workiva, and other financial systems, with a focus on streamlining workflows, increasing automation, strengthening controls, and improving the efficiency, accuracy, and timeliness of financial close and reporting processes. The role serves as a key post-production lead within Finance Administration, partnering closely with Accounting, Financial Reporting, and cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure scalable, well-governed financial systems and reporting solutions.

Supervisory Authority

This position does not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

This role serves as the functional lead for Record-to-Report within Workday Financials, with responsibility for post‑production support, optimization, and continuous improvement across the financial close, accounting, and reporting lifecycle. The Senior Analyst – R2R Lead owns the configurations, governance, and optimization of Record-to-Report related Workday Financials processes, including accounting posting rules, journal processing, reconciliations, validations, and reporting. The role also oversees the Workiva platform, ensuring effective integration with Workday Financials and alignment with financial reporting, close, and control requirements.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the functional lead for Record-to-Report operations within Workday Financials, supporting period‑end close, accounting, reconciliation, and financial reporting processes.

  • Lead functional analysis, design, configuration, testing, and delivery of Workday Financials reporting (dashboards and reports), including PRISM analytics strategies to support Finance Administration and institutional business needs.

  • Oversee the Workiva platform, including coordination of integrations with Workday Financials, support of financial statement preparation, and alignment with reporting and close processes.
  • Coordinate and lead system testing activities, including troubleshooting report‑related issues, regression testing and user acceptance testing (UAT), to ensure stakeholders reporting requirements are met.
  • Develop report writing standards, best practices, and management of financial report repository.
  • Partner with Accounting, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and cross‑functional stakeholders to document requirements, develop use cases, and ensure solutions align with accounting and reporting standards.
  • Support post‑production road‑mapping, continuous improvement initiatives, and timely delivery of system enhancements related to financial close and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly summarize the financial accounting and reporting impact of system configurations and changes.
  • Strong organizational and execution skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and deliver results under time‑sensitive conditions.
  • Deep understanding of Record-to-Report processes, including period end close, reconciliations, financial reporting, and internal controls.
  • Detail‑oriented, analytical, and proactive problem solver with a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • An active an agile learner, able to apply new tools, features, and best practices to evolving financial operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate accounting and reporting requirements into effective system configurations and automated solutions.

Minimum Requirements

  • MBA, MIS, or a bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, computer science or related field from an accredited University, with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Workday certification or demonstrated proficiency in Record-to-Report and at least one Workday Financial Management area (Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, or PRISM). Candidates who do not currently hold required certification must obtain or demonstrate proficiency within twelve (12) months of employment.
  • Experience with Workday’s reporting tools, such as Report Writer (Advance Report, Composite Report, PRISM).
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain respectful, collaborative working relationships with staff, faculty, students, and stakeholders.

title: Analista de Crédito
description:
Overview

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar de forma analítica e estratégica na avaliação de risco de crédito, por meio da análise aprofundada de demonstrações financeiras, entendimento da dinâmica operacional e setorial dos clientes, leitura do cenário macroeconômico e das condições de mercado, assegurando decisões de crédito alinhadas à sustentabilidade financeira, rentabilidade e mitigação de riscos da Betunel.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar análise econômico-financeira completa dos clientes, com leitura crítica de balanços patrimoniais, demonstrações de resultados, fluxo de caixa, endividamento, estrutura de capital, liquidez, rentabilidade e capacidade de geração de caixa.
  • Avaliar a capacidade de pagamento e de execução operacional dos clientes, considerando histórico de adimplência, carteira de contratos/obras, perfil de recebíveis (especialmente públicos), concentração de risco, garantias e exposição global de crédito.
  • Analisar o posicionamento do cliente no mercado, seu setor de atuação, nível de competitividade, dependência de contratos públicos ou privados, ciclo do negócio e sensibilidade a variações econômicas.
  • Monitorar o cenário macroeconômico e setorial (juros, inflação, crédito, investimentos em infraestrutura, orçamento público, funding bancário), avaliando impactos diretos na capacidade financeira dos clientes e no risco da carteira.
  • Calcular e revisar limites e necessidades de crédito com base na programação de vendas, volumes contratados, preços, exposição já concedida, garantias existentes e perfil de risco.
  • Propor atualizações na Política de Crédito, considerando mudanças econômicas, regulatórias, práticas de mercado, custos financeiros, execução de garantias e estratégias da concorrência.
  • Estruturar, aprimorar e operacionalizar modelos de análise de crédito, critérios de rating, segmentação de risco e instrumentos de mitigação.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores de risco (aging, concentração, exposição, inadimplência, comportamento de pagamento).
  • Contribuir para a automação das análises, segurança das informações e uso de ferramentas analíticas e dashboards para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Ciências Econômicas, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento da dinâmica de diferentes fontes de recursos (capital próprio, crédito bancário, recebíveis, contratos públicos).
  • Conhecimento em análise de balanços, DRE, fluxo de caixa e indicadores financeiros.
  • Conhecimento em finanças corporativas e matemática financeira.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de análise de crédito e gestão de risco.
  • Análise de mercado, tendências macro e microeconômicas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e construção de dashboards analíticos.
  • Noções de legislação relacionada a crédito, garantias e execução.
  • Experiência em análise de crédito, preferencialmente em setores de infraestrutura, construção, indústria ou serviços B2B.
  • Vivência em análise de demonstrações financeiras, avaliação de risco, leitura de mercado e acompanhamento de clientes.
  • Experiência com análise de concorrência, ambiente econômico e movimentações setoriais.

Responsibilities

Qualifications

As per Seadrill training and competence directives.

About Us

SAFETY AT SEADRILL Our goal is to ensure that ‘nobody gets hurt' whilst performing their job. Everyone at Seadrill has a part to play in meeting our safety commitment.

Through strong leadership and personal responsibility from all employees, we take a systematic approach to identifying, managing and preventing the hazards involved in our day to day operations.

Nothing is more important to us than the health, safety and security of our workforce and the communities in which we operate and behaving responsibly towards our shared environment.

We are vigilant, disciplined and always looking out for one another. We have developed and embedded a strong safety culture onshore and offshore, fostered by all employees, who each have a personal responsibility and the authority to put an immediate stop to the job if they believe it to be unsafe.

Everyone at Seadrill is accountable for helping to build this culture of care. This includes:

  • Compliance with the Seadrill Code of Conduct and Fight Against Corruption.
  • Compliance with applicable internal and external governing requirements.
  • Non-compliances are promptly acted on and reported to the direct supervisor.
  • The standard for tidiness and cleanness is adhered to.
  • Good and clear communications with all involved parties.

SEADRILL BEHAVIORAL FRAMEWORK

In Seadrill, setting the standard is not just about what we deliver, but how we deliver it. We co-created our Behavioral Framework with our employees, where we identified four key competencies that define our culture and help us to live our values. Our behaviors are embedded in the way we work and support and guide us day to day:

  • Drive & Ownership
  • Change & Forward Thinking
  • Communication & Collaboration
  • Service Delivery

Join Seadrill

We value our people and want to retain them. So, we offer a competitive package built around an attractive base salary and a range of benefits tailored to your location.

Join Seadrill. Own the Opportunity.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) serves as the operational and administrative anchor of the Office of the Dean and is the primary front-facing representative for the College of Arts & Sciences. Reporting to the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, this role is responsible for managing day-to-day administrative operations, front office services, facilities coordination, vendor and procurement activities, and student staff supervision to ensure a professional, efficient, and well-coordinated Dean’s Office.

Supervisory Authority

  • Supervises front desk staff and work-study students assigned to the Office of the Dean
  • Responsible for scheduling, training, task assignment, and performance feedback for student and administrative support staff
  • Provides functional guidance to administrative staff supporting front office operations

Nature And Scope

The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) works closely with the Dean, Chief of Staff, Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, associate deans, faculty, staff, students, visitors, vendors, and university service partners (e.g., Facilities, Procurement, IT). This role exercises independent judgment in managing administrative operations, resolving day-to-day issues, and coordinating resources to support executive leadership and college-wide operations.

Principal Accountabilities

Front Office & Executive Operations

  • Serve as the primary front office presence for the Office of the Dean, ensuring a professional, welcoming, and well-managed environment
  • Manage front desk operations, visitor reception, and daily office readiness
  • Coordinate administrative logistics for meetings, events, and executive activities within the Dean’s Office
  • Maintain consistent front office protocols and service standards

Administrative Operations & Workflow Management

  • Establish and maintain administrative procedures, workflows, and internal operating practices for the Office of the Dean
  • Manage document control, records management, and administrative filing systems
  • Draft, maintain, and update non-HR administrative standard operating procedures (SOPs)
  • Coordinate internal communications and administrative scheduling within the Dean’s Office

Student & Administrative Support Oversight

  • Supervise work-study students and front desk staff, including scheduling, onboarding, task delegation, and time submission coordination
  • Ensure adequate front office coverage and operational continuity
  • Support administrative onboarding logistics for new staff (workspace readiness, access coordination, supplies), referring all HR-related actions to the HR Operations Coordinator

Facilities & Building Operations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for facilities, maintenance, and building operations for the Office of the Dean
  • Coordinate building safety, space readiness, and maintenance requests
  • Monitor office infrastructure needs and escalate issues as appropriate to Facilities Management

Vendor, Procurement & Resource Management

  • Coordinate procurement of goods and services in accordance with university policies
  • Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, renewals, and pricing coordination
  • Track contracts, service timelines, and vendor deliverables (non-legal review)
  • Maintain inventory, office supplies, and resource allocation for the Dean’s Office
  • Oversee procurement card (P-Card) activity, including transaction processing, reconciliation, and compliance with university procurement policies

Operational Partnership & Special Projects

  • Partner with the Chief of Staff on administrative initiatives, operational improvements, and special projects
  • Support the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration with administrative coordination and operational reporting as needed
  • Identify opportunities to improve front office efficiency, service delivery, and administrative consistency
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements for the Dean, as needed, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and adherence to university travel guidelines

Core Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of administrative and office operations principles
  • Demonstrated ability to manage front office services in a complex academic environment
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality
  • Strong vendor coordination and procurement management skills
  • Ability to supervise and develop student and administrative support staff
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and operate independently
  • Working knowledge of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including Workday
  • Proficiency with office productivity tools (Word, Excel, Outlook) and administrative systems

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, or a related field
  • 4–6 years of progressively responsible experience in administrative or operations management
  • Experience supporting executive offices or senior leadership preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered

$55,000-$65,000

title: Managing Consultant, Customer Success
description:
Overview

Company Overview
Libryo, an ERM Group Company, is a global SaaS platform that empowers multinational organizations to understand and comply with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) law and broader ESG requirements. Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, the world’s largest pure-play sustainability consultancy, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid-to-senior-level role with potential people management responsibilities. This individual will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You’ll work across departments to deliver a high-quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM)
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
    • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision-makers across large multinational organizations.
    • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.
  • Customer Implementations
    • Lead end-to-end delivery of customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Legal Content, RIDE, and Product) to deliver on time and to spec.
    • Work with key stakeholders to map customer-specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
    • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.
  • Renewal & Retention Management
    • Take full ownership of renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for their allocated customer portfolio and region.
    • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
    • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem-solving.
  • Strategic Account Growth
    • Identify and support growth opportunities, including cross-sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
    • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to enable account expansion.
    • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement, stakeholder behavior, and evolving needs.
  • Platform Mastery & Support
    • As a senior member of the Customer Success team, develop deep expertise across Libryo’s full suite of tools, including the Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, and ERM Assess. Deliver high-level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms. Play a key role in ensuring a consistent, professional, and high-quality user experience across every touchpoint, reinforcing Libryo’s reputation for excellence and reliability in regulatory technology.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Product, Support, Customer Intelligence) to ensure each customer receives seamless, aligned service.
    • Participate in customer health reviews, product feedback loops, and ongoing support escalations when needed.
    • May manage and mentor junior Customer Success team members, contributing to team strategy and development.
  • Customer Reporting & Communication
    • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with strategic insight, platform metrics, and tailored recommendations.
    • Maintain CRM hygiene in HubSpot, ensuring accurate tracking of org structures, usage data, and renewal timelines.
    • Provide input to internal reporting (e.g., churn forecasting, customer health scores, and CS dashboards).
  • Experience & Qualifications
    • Fluent in English (additional languages is a huge plus, particularly Spanish).
    • Bachelor's degree in business, legal, environmental sciences, or a related discipline. A legal background is a strong advantage.
    • 5+ years of customer success/account management experience in a B2B SaaS, compliance, legal-tech, or ESG space.
    • Demonstrated success managing strategic enterprise accounts and driving customer growth and renewals.
    • Proven ability to lead complex customer implementations, manage cross-functional projects, and navigate senior stakeholder relationships.
    • Exposure to international accounts, with an understanding of NA/LATAM business contexts and cultural nuance.
    • Strong command of HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, Excel/Sheets, and reporting/BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
    • Experience managing or mentoring junior team members or working in a leadership pod structure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Highest quality of work delivered
  • High engagement and satisfaction across assigned customer accounts.
  • Successful and on-time delivery of all customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Clear account growth paths identified and supported with strategic input.
  • Renewals closed predictably and proactively with limited commercial risk.
  • Clean, current data and insight-driven QBRs shared with customers and leadership.

Platform Expertise & Training

Develop deep knowledge of the Libryo platform and associated tools to support effective onboarding, training, and engagement. Deliver live training sessions and contribute to documentation, including Knowledge Base content for customer self-service.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Assist in collecting and analyzing customer feedback and reviewing internal workflows to improve the end-to-end customer journey. Help refine internal operational processes to improve delivery consistency, reduce friction, and ensure high-quality service across customer segments.

Thank you for your interest in ERM!

title: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
Introduction

We are looking for the right people - people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You'll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

title: Managing Consultant, Customer Success
description:
Company Overview

Libryo, an ERM Group Company, is a global SaaS platform that empowers multinational organizations to understand and comply with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) law and broader ESG requirements. Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, the world’s largest pure‑play sustainability consultancy, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid‑to‑senior‑level role with potential people management responsibilities. This individual will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You’ll work across departments to deliver a high‑quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM)

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision‑makers across large multinational organizations.
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.

Customer Implementations

  • Lead end‑to‑end delivery of customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Legal Content, RIDE, and Product) to deliver on time and to spec.
  • Work with key stakeholders to map customer‑specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
  • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.

Renewal & Retention Management

  • Take full ownership of renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for their allocated customer portfolio and region.
  • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
  • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem‑solving.

Strategic Account Growth

  • Identify and support growth opportunities, including cross‑sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
  • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to enable account expansion.
  • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement, stakeholder behavior, and evolving needs.

Platform Mastery & Support

  • As a senior member of the Customer Success team, you will be expected to develop deep expertise across Libryo’s full suite of tools, including the Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, and ERM Assess. This role requires you to deliver high‑level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms. You’ll play a key role in ensuring a consistent, professional, and high‑quality user experience across every touchpoint, reinforcing Libryo’s reputation for excellence and reliability in regulatory technology.

Team Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Product, Support, Customer Intelligence) to ensure each customer receives seamless, aligned service.
  • Participate in customer health reviews, product feedback loops, and ongoing support escalations when needed.
  • May manage and mentor junior Customer Success team members, contributing to team strategy and development.

Customer Reporting & Communication

  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with strategic insight, platform metrics, and tailored recommendations.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene in HubSpot, ensuring accurate tracking of org structures, usage data, and renewal timelines.
  • Provide input to internal reporting (e.g., churn forecasting, customer health scores, and CS dashboards).

Experience & Qualifications

  • Fluent in English (additional languages is a huge plus, particularly Spanish)
  • Bachelor's degree in business, legal, environmental sciences, or a related discipline. A legal background is a strong advantage.
  • 5+ years of customer success/account management experience in a B2B SaaS, compliance, legal‑tech, or ESG space.
  • Demonstrated success managing strategic enterprise accounts and driving customer growth and renewals.
  • Proven ability to lead complex customer implementations, manage cross‑functional projects, and navigate senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Exposure to international accounts, with an understanding of NA/LATAM business contexts and cultural nuance.
  • Strong command of HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, Excel/Sheets, and reporting/BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
  • Experience managing or mentoring junior team members or working in a leadership pod structure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Highest quality of work delivered
  • High engagement and satisfaction across assigned customer accounts.
  • Successful and on‑time delivery of all customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Clear account growth paths identified and supported with strategic input.
  • Renewals closed predictably and proactively with limited commercial risk.
  • Clean, current data and insight‑driven QBRs shared with customers and leadership.

Platform Expertise & Training

Develop deep knowledge of the Libryo platform and associated tools to support effective onboarding, training, and engagement. Deliver live training sessions and contribute to documentation, including Knowledge Base content for customer self‑service.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Assist in collecting and analyzing customer feedback and reviewing internal workflows to improve the end‑to‑end customer journey. Help refine internal operational processes to improve delivery consistency, reduce friction, and ensure high‑quality service across customer segments.

Tha nk you for your interest in ERM!

We’re a tight-knit team of creative, data-driven people, continuously building services & partnering with the world’s largest brands.

The Role

We’re hiring a hands-on IT Manager who is also an AI nerd — someone who gets excited about building intelligent systems, automating away manual work, and designing modern, secure infrastructure for a fully remote company.

This role blends IT ownership, cybersecurity leadership, and applied AI systems building . You’ll handle access and security day-to-day, but the real leverage comes from designing smarter workflows, AI-assisted ops, and security systems that scale across a global team.

Compliance & Trust

  • Own GDPR compliance and data-handling standards.

IT Strategy & Cost Control

  • Audit our current environment and design an optimized roadmap.

  • Own IT vendors, contracts, and seat management.

  • Use data and automation to track usage, waste, and spend.

Google Workspace

ClickUp

Notion

Webflow

Clockify

NordPass

Frame.io

Figma

Zapier

n8n

QuickBooks

PeopleForce

Ashby

Fathom

You’ll help decide what stays, what goes, and what gets automated.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong hands-on IT or systems background (remote-first experience preferred).

  • Comfort scripting, working with APIs, and building real systems (not demos).

  • Solid understanding of identity, access, and security fundamentals.

  • Experience responding to real-world security issues (impersonation, phishing, abuse).

  • Ability to explain risk, tradeoffs, and systems clearly to non-technical leaders.

  • Bias toward building, testing, and improving systems continuously.

Bonus Points

  • You’ve built internal AI tools, agents, or automations.

  • Experience designing security from scratch.

  • Exposure to healthcare, staffing, or regulated environments.

Why This Role Is Different

Benefits
